pages.text: $(thing)Late Blight$() ($(o)Phytophthora infestans$()), oomycete.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() potato, tomato.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores, rain splash, seedborne.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-25 °C (best 18 °C), humidity above 90%, 10 h of wet leaves.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0.2 years (infected tubers).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 100% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Certified disease-free seed potatoes; Destroy cull piles and volunteers; Protectant fungicide programme; Resistant varieties.
Caused the Irish Potato Famine of 1845-1849.
